{{Quote|We do have an ex-Imperial in our pocket who might have some information for you. Sergeant Moore owed Nym several thousand credits. He'll probably tell you whatever you need to know, for a price.|[[Jinkins]], to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:SwSM" />}}
'''Moore''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as [[sub-officer]] in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] until he was discharged during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Empire found out that he was borrowing credits from Nym. He was going to be executed, but he has friends in the Tagge family. They put in a good word, and Moore was kicked out instead of killed.|Jinkins, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SwSM" />}}
Moore joined the Imperial Army and eventually rose to the rank of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] where he worked in the [[Imperial Mine (Lok)|Imperial Mine]].<ref name="SWG:SwSM" /> During his stay on the barren outlaw world, he got involved with the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] and the pirate [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] himself and borrowed several thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] from the pirate warlord. When the Empire found out about his deal with Nym he was to be executed. But Moore had friends in the powerful [[House of Tagge/Legends|Tagge family]] who put in a good word, so Moore was merely evicted instead of killed.<ref name="SWG:FJ" />

After he had to leave the Imperial Army, Moore spent most of his time in the [[Stronghold Cantina|cantina]] in [[Nym's Stronghold]]. Nym's pirates occasionally paid him for information about the Empire's local operations.<ref name="SWG:FJ" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] sent by [[Jinkins]] of the Lok Revenants paid him 150 credits for Moore's insider knowledge about the Imperial mine and the [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]] that guarded the facility.<ref name="SWG:SwSM" /> Soon after the spacer visited him again and paid him for information about the [[Imperial Research Facility (Lok)|Imperial Research Facility]].<ref name="SWG:SwSMa">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Speak with Sergeant Moore, again|Lok}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sergeant Moore is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SwSM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Sergeant Moore was added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Nym's Theme Park|Nym's Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:SwSM" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 3 Notes: 8 October 03|Publish 3]]" on [[October 8]], 2003.<ref name="SonyCite-Publish 3: The Warren">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?o=60890|text=Publish 3: The Warren}}</ref> Moore's dialogue was slightly expanded when the questline was revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 16|Game Update 16]]," on [[March 23]], [[2010]].<ref name="SonyCite-Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=68713&month=032010|text=Game Update 16: ''Star Wars'' Galaxies™: Stronghold of the Lok Revenants}}</ref>
